verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RUN paying employees and contractors with US tax handling: 1099/W-2 filing, multi-state jurisdictions, and IRS e-filing. Nothing documents paying international contractors, paying in local or foreign currencies, or generating locally compliant contractor contracts. The general mention of paying contractors is US-centric and does not cover the cross-border, multi-currency part of this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts
